title: 第7章 活着就是为了找死第8章 二入宗门
slug: 模拟修仙杀我者恩人也
lines: 【冤有头，债有主】
【修仙之路，步步为营，一朝不慎，空留白骨】
【假如我也有一本功法，是不是能逆转死局，成为神秘凶手那样的人物？】
【前世遗泽：鬼道一品圣典《万煞鬼神相》】
王易睁开眼睛，面前是一模一样的厨房，熟悉的场景。
唯一不同的是，自己的脑子里多了一本庞大无比，复杂晦涩到难以附加的鬼道圣典。
他脑子格外沉重，一时间愣在原地，做不出反应。
周浩问：“你知道吗，三小姐回来了。”
王易应了一声：“知道了。”
“你知道了？”
周浩手里的勺子一顿，表情忽然变得怪异：“你是从哪儿听说的？”
“柳翠告诉我的，她没和你说吗？”
王易此时根本没心思应付周浩，口中敷衍的胡言乱语。
只是说者有心，听者更是有意。
周浩一听这话，表情瞬间低沉了下来，心情沉入谷底。
廋厨子不再吭声，连锅里的汤面都忘了拿出来。
王易独自坐在门外，脑子里思绪万千，心情莫名怅然。
历经生死两次，他似乎弄明白了自己活着的意义。
“我活着，就是为了找死啊！”
别人怕死，是因为没有从头再来的机会。
但王易不同，他的身体里有一面神秘铜镜。
对他而言，死亡并不是终点，而是重新开始的人生。
“更何况，每死一次，我都会从凶手身上得到一份无比珍贵的前世遗泽。”
第一世，周浩给了他三品灵根；
第二世，少年掉了本鬼道圣典。
一世灵根，一世功法，一世又一世，千生万世总有登临大道的那一世。
王易抬起头，看着云散天明，心中豁然开朗。
——原来死亡，是一件如此美妙的事情。
他活着的目标，就应该竭尽所能找到这一世能遇见最强大，的最恐怖的敌人，然后坦然赴死。
content_en:
[Every injustice has its owner, every debt has its owner]
[The road to cultivating immortality is one step at a time, but if you are not careful, you will leave nothing but bones]
[If I also had a skill, could I reverse the situation and become a mysterious murderer? 】
[Legacy of the Past Life: The First-Rank Holy Code of the Ghost Path "The Appearances of All Evil Ghosts and Gods"]
…
Wang Yi opened his eyes and saw the same kitchen in front of him, a familiar scene.
The only difference is that there is an extremely huge, complex and obscure ghost scripture in his mind.
His mind was extremely heavy, and he was stunned for a moment, unable to react.
Zhou Hao asked: "Did you know that the third lady is back?"
Wang Yi responded: "I understand."
"You know?"
Zhou Hao paused with the spoon in his hand, and his expression suddenly became strange: "Where did you hear about it?"
"Liu Cui told me, didn't she tell you?"
Wang Yi had no intention of dealing with Zhou Hao at this time and kept talking nonsense.
It’s just that the speaker is intentional, and the listener is even more intentional.
When Zhou Hao heard this, his expression instantly darkened and his mood sank to the bottom.
The thin cook said nothing and even forgot to take out the soup noodles from the pot.
…
Wang Yi sat alone outside the door, with countless thoughts in his mind and feeling inexplicably sad.
After experiencing life and death twice, he seems to have figured out the meaning of his life.
"I live just to seek death!"
Others are afraid of death because they have no chance to start over.
But Wang Yi is different. There is a mysterious bronze mirror in his body.
For him, death is not the end, but the beginning of life again.
"What's more, every time I die, I will receive an extremely precious legacy from the murderer."
In his first life, Zhou Hao gave him a third-grade spiritual root;
In the second life, the boy dropped a copy of the Holy Code of Ghost Path.
One life's spiritual roots, one life's skills, one life after another, and in thousands of lives, there will always be a life where you can reach the great road.
Wang Yi raised his head, looked at the clouds disappearing, and suddenly felt enlightened.
——It turns out that death is such a wonderful thing.
His goal in life is to do his best to find the most powerful and terrifying enemy he can meet in this life, and then die calmly.
title_en: Chapter 7 Living is to seek death Chapter 8 Entering the sect for the second time
